policyDisclosure.startup: Each actual console shows 37 rules, companion required, device required and VM DENY. No claim of captured all-13-key default file before protocol: helper overwrites guard.properties for QA.
policyDisclosure.namedChanges: 10-second OP gate, IP deny 127.0.0.0/8, VM DENY/VBS control, and final max-online-per-IP=2; source snapshots preserve exact sequence.
policyDisclosure.scope: Real loopback TCP, synthetic self-reports/accounts/devices. No graphical companion, physical VM, third-party Grim/Anti-Xray, load/performance, or all-cheat accuracy proof.
